title: A badge is not proof
body: A caller can claim to be from the police, CBI, RBI, a bank, or a court. Hang up and use a number from the organisation's official website or your card.

title: Pressure is a red flag
body: Threats of arrest, account closure, or a deadline are designed to stop you thinking. Take a pause; legitimate organisations allow independent verification.

title: You never have to keep a call secret
body: Scammers isolate people by saying do not disconnect or tell your family. A trustworthy official will not stop you from asking someone you trust.

title: An OTP is for you only
body: Banks, wallets, and government services will never need you to read out an OTP, PIN, CVV, or password. Anyone asking is trying to take control.

title: Verify before you act
body: End the call and contact the organisation through its official app, website, card, or a statement. Never use a callback number supplied by a suspicious caller.

title: Do not install remote-access apps
body: AnyDesk, TeamViewer, and screen-sharing requests can give a stranger access to your device and accounts. Official support will not ask for this during a surprise call.

title: There is no digital arrest
body: Police and courts do not arrest people over a video call or demand a transfer to a safe account. This story is a known impersonation tactic.

title: UPI collects are not refunds
body: To receive money, you do not enter a UPI PIN or approve a collect request. Read every screen carefully and decline unexpected requests.

title: Banks do not need your secrets
body: A real bank can verify your identity without asking for your full PIN, OTP, or password. Use the bank's official support channel when unsure.

title: Fear and kindness can both be exploited
body: Scammers may invent an emergency, a reward, or a family crisis. Slow down, check the story with another person, and do not let emotion choose for you.

title: Check in with older family members
body: Older adults are often targeted with authority and investment stories. Agree on a family pause phrase and encourage a second opinion before any payment.

title: Keep official channels close
body: Save your bank's number from its website, the National Cyber Crime Helpline 1930, and local emergency services. Reporting quickly can improve the chance of help.
